name: presence
description: LD2410C OUT. With no sensor (0x8000) the screen never switches to the away page.

name: hub
description: MQTT broker / Home Assistant link. offline turns the AI card into the offline card.

name: synced_ago
description: Since the last good exchange with the hub. Write 0 after each publish or message; the display counts up (“Synced 2 min ago”). 0xFFFF = never.

name: retry_in
description: To the next reconnect attempt; the offline card counts down (“retry in 0:42”). 0 = no countdown.

name: unix_time
description: High word first. 0 = unknown: no clock shown.

name: utc_offset
description: Local offset from UTC: −240 = EDT, −300 = EST.

name: room
description: This node's room: its name in the top bar and the This display tile on the rooms page.

name: away_after
description: Away page after this long without presence. 0 = never.

name: rotate_pages
values: 0=off; 1=sensors and rooms pages, 10 s each per minute
description: Off keeps the AI message on screen at all times (the team's layout rule).

name: mode
default: 0 (auto: demo until the first write, then live)
values: 0=auto: demo until the first write, then live; 1=live only; 2=demo only

name: led_brightness
description: Light bar, as a share of its safe maximum (0–100)

name: inputs_reset
description: Write 0x5AA5 to put every input back to its power-up value. Do it when the node boots.

name: room_name
description: Overrides the top bar's room name. Empty = the name of room.

name: panel_state
description: The DWIN panel behind the display

name: writes_rejected
description: Write frames outside the map or to read-only words

name: message_ts
description: The payload's ts, for “2 min ago”. 0 = none: counted from arrival.

name: message_text
description: The payload's text. Empty = the card's idle line. 512 bytes take 3 frames: at 0x1100, 0x1178 and 0x11F0.

name: thinking
description: While not empty the card shows the spinning orb and this line (“Reading 6 sensors across 3 rooms…”). Write empty, or a new message, to end it.

name: chip1_value
description: After an arrow: “40%”. Empty for none.

name: chip2_value
description: After an arrow: “40%”. Empty for none.

name: toast_trigger
description: Write a new value (count up) to show the toast. Fill the fields in the same frame or before.

name: alert_value
description: Shown big. Same scaling as that reading: temperature °C × 10, humidity × 10, others whole.

name: alert_since
description: Since it started; the display counts up.

name: alert_message
description: “Probably the stove. I'll tell you when the air clears.”

name: alert_done1_value
description: After an arrow: “40%”. Empty for none.

name: alert_done2_value
description: After an arrow: “40%”. Empty for none.

name: alert_ask_value
description: After an arrow: “40%”. Empty for none.

name: room1_online
description: Automatic: this node's own room fills itself from the sensor block; other rooms show offline.

description: Automatic: this node's own room fills itself from the sensor block; other rooms show offline.
